name: EO1H-313K-v2
description: EO1H-313K-v2 is an Earth-observation (satellite/remote-sensing) image dataset of roughly 313K samples designed to evaluate models on common remote-sensing tasks. It is intended to measure performance on supervised vision tasks such as land-cover or object classification and detection across varied geospatial conditions. Standard remote-sensing metrics are used to compare models, and the dataset targets scalable evaluation for research in geospatial image understanding.
reputation: Relatively new dataset within the remote sensing community with modest adoption outside specialized geospatial research.
